# einksmart

> einksmart supplies Canvas color E-Ink frames, OEM inserts and project displays for B2B samples and deployments. Hardware, firmware and software scope are confirmed per model and project.

Sample and project pricing is by quotation. 7.09-inch units are DVT engineering samples. Confirm 5.89-inch sample scheduling and A3 batch availability. 1.54-inch specifications and the 7.3-inch complete-unit configuration require review. Bluetooth devices do not inherit Wi-Fi frame features. Scheduling, CMS and APIs are not universal standard features.
